reveal_en: On Venus, a single rotation on its axis takes 243 Earth days. However, its orbit around the Sun is completed in just 225 Earth days. This means a day on Venus is actually longer than its year.
reveal_zh: 金星自转一周需243个地球日，但它绕太阳公转一周只需225个地球日。因此，金星上的一天比一年还要长。
meaning_en: Our intuitive sense of time and planetary motion is often challenged by the bizarre realities of the cosmos.
meaning_zh: 宇宙的奇特规律常常颠覆我们对时间和行星运动的直观认知。

visual.motion: Slow, ponderous rotation of a clouded planet, with a swift orbit animation.
